subject: [hw] T01 -> lead: V14 patch still not applied; it is the only thing keeping thumb-O0 from zero scalar mismatches
body: R1s verified patch is at gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/v14-fix.patch but gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t16.c mtime is still 11:21. With the patch applied in a /tmp copy, thumb-O0 mismatches go from 676 to 0 (k_switch_dense is already fixed by V16; the rest are this LSRS/ASRS-register-by-0 bug plus vector kernels that also fail at arm-O2). Current run_diff: arm-O0 2600/2600 PASS, arm-O2 2435/2600, thumb-O0 1904/2600 mostly V14. Can you apply it, or authorize me to apply that exact patch? I will not touch V14s file without your word.
